title: Task service module renamed by a refactor
purpose: Drift: a stored fact names a path that a refactor just moved. The old claim must not stay active unchanged, and its history must be kept.

payload.claim: Task access rules (owner or admin) live in app/services/tasks.py in TaskService._check_access.

event.content:
commit (refactor) Split task service into package

 app/services/{tasks.py => task_service.py}     |  2 +-
 app/services/access.py                         | 12 ++++++
Access checks moved from TaskService._check_access to app/services/access.py: can_access(user, task).
